run_make_test_output: run the script to gather test run output and create a JUnit XML file for Jenkins
readtests_parse_joblog: read test results from a parallel joblog file and stdout/stderr logs into a sorted list of test dicts
genxml_create_junit_xml: generate a JUnit-format XML string from a list of test result dictionaries with stdout, stderr, and failure info
review_readtests_parsing: review the readtests function to understand how it parses tab-separated joblog entries and reads per-test stdout and stderr files
refactor_genxml_xml_generation: refactor the genxml function to customize the JUnit XML output structure or add additional test metadata fields
